newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called 0.10 firmer, eyes on weather.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called 0.10 firmer, eyes on weather.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent firmer Monday based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.
The market will remain focused on the weather which over the weekend remained favorable in Texas and the Southwest as well as in the Delta and Southeast.
Friday, most-active December delivery finished at 74.66 cents a lb, up 0.10 cent from Thursday, after trading from 74.35 to 74.60 cents.
Technical resistance was pegged at 75.20 cents, with support seen at Friday's low of 74.35 cents, for December cotton.
